answer: Sybil swarms mint cheap IDs to seize seats. Mechanism: each new identity must park a 9 POA bond in a karst vault for 36h, then publish a ledge hash of three live peer countersigns plus a quill digest of its first graded answer. Cost: 0.4 POA vault fee and ~90s peer verify. Verification: peers recompute the ledge hash against on-ledger attests. Failure: fewer than 2 countersigns in 6h burns 3 POA and locks further answers until rebond.
